scope: Nominal deposited G-code footprint screening; does not prove physical bed adhesion, stiffness or thread fit.
stability_limits: 50 mm tall, 4.4 mm wide upper tube; height/body-width ratio 11.36. Integral 12 x 12 x 0.24 mm foot provides bed contact but no lateral support above bed.
Continuous supported footprints only rule out disconnected islands; they do not qualify upright stability, adhesion, nozzle collision or PLA wall stiffness.
No generated supports touch the bore/thread; remove only the thin external foot after printing, keeping tools away from the female thread.
Confirm clean bed and complete first-layer attachment; stop if the tube wobbles or foot lifts. Actual tall-print stability remains untested.
